step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Benefit type requested] — not entitled — D12 from w/c XXXX-X to XXXX-X.”

Details: Type: “Not allowed — the client was incarcerated from (YYYY-MM-DD) to (YYYY-MM-DD). References: EIA 37 , Digest 11.6.5 — Being an inmate in any prison or similar institution and the National Policy on the Levels of Decision .” EIA 37 Digest 11.6.5 — Being an inmate in any prison or similar institution National Policy on the Levels of Decision

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the incarceration issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 3.

If no , select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the claim is in MPS:

ul.li: If no, go to step 4.
If yes, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA01 (if necessary) and impose a D12 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Manual action: Select 1 - General suspension of benefits (stop payment) , if necessary.
Rescind: Check the box, if necessary.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 12 - Inmate in penal institution .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.

End date: Enter the appropriate end date as follows:
If the end date is known, enter the disentitlement end date.
If the end date is not known, click Indefinite .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes to complete the registration number.
Click Update .
Go to step 8.

step.cmd: In FTS Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Click Memo (MPS) .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim requiring the D13/61 to be modified or terminated.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Payment System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks Line 1: Type “DE12 from [XXXX-X to XXXX-X]”
Remarks Line 2: If necessary, type other information or changes needed.
Remarks Line 3: If necessary, type “Send stored ACS [name of letter]”
Remarks Line 4: Type your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send (or save in case of a MPS claim) the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlements (2976): Select D5, D12, D13, D14, D23 .
D12 - In prison or similar institution .
Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Overpayment messages (2452) .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the incarceration issue.
